name: GDPS Full Rater
description: GDPS moderator rating interface using original in-game Geometry Dash difficulty faces and persistent server-side ratings.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: Trusted GDPS HTTPS folder containing gdpsFullRaterGet.php and gdpsFullRaterSet.php, for example https://YOUR-GDPS-DOMAIN/database/ (keep the final slash). This setting is for the Cvolton-compatible PHP add-on, NOT a Supabase project URL. Your GDPS GJP2 token is sent here for server-side verification; use only a server you control or trust.

disable-daily-button.name: Disable Daily Button
disable-daily-button.description: Hide the Set Daily command button.

disable-weekly-button.name: Disable Weekly Button
disable-weekly-button.description: Hide the Set Weekly command button.

disable-send-only-button.name: Disable Send Only Button
disable-send-only-button.description: Hide the Send Only command button.
